pricing.metaDesc: Registering and listing on ePetrecere.md is free. You pay only 5% of confirmed orders the platform brings you.
pricing.h1: List for free. Pay only when you earn.
pricing.sub: No subscription and no registration fee. The platform takes a fee only on the confirmed orders it brings you.
pricing.freeDesc: A full profile, catalogue presence and direct client requests — with no recurring cost.
pricing.inc1: Complete public profile — photos, video, description, contact
pricing.inc2: Presence in the catalogue, search and category pages
pricing.feeDesc: For artists and service providers — 5% of the value of a confirmed order obtained through ePetrecere.md. It applies only once a booking reaches the 'confirmed' status.
pricing.fee1: Calculation base: the full order value, including add-on services that form part of it.
pricing.fee2: Payment term: 10 calendar days from the invoice or notice.
pricing.fee3: Everything is visible in your account: the booking, value, rate, amount and payment status.
pricing.venuesNote: the fee is agreed separately, depending on the event type, and communicated before it becomes due.
pricing.a1: Nothing. Registration and standard publication of your profile are free (Tariffs §1). There are no Basic/Pro/Premium packages at this stage.
pricing.a2: For artists and service providers: 5% of the value of a confirmed order obtained through the platform, including add-on services that form part of the order (Tariffs §2–§3).
pricing.q3: When does the payment obligation arise?
pricing.a3: The moment a booking reaches the 'Confirmed order' status (Tariffs §5). Payment is due within 10 calendar days of the invoice or notice (§7).
pricing.q4: What do venues and restaurants pay?
pricing.a4: The venue fee is agreed separately, depending on the event type, and communicated before the obligation arises (Tariffs §4, Venue Agreement §13.2). There are no hidden fees.
pricing.q5: What happens if the event is cancelled?
pricing.a5: Cancellation does not automatically cancel the fee, but it can be recalculated depending on who cancelled, why, and how far execution had progressed. If the event did not take place and keeping the fee would be unjustified, the amount is corrected (Tariffs §10).
pricing.a6: No. Optional paid services — advertising, promotion, analytics — may appear in future, but they are never activated automatically (Tariffs §12).
